doc: Design §11 row 6: kill a networked job's sidecar; the job ends `infra: proxy` with the sidecar's exit code in its log, row 1's probes repeated in the job until it ends still fail (no route appears, 1.1.1.1 stays unreachable), and no container with the job's label is left. Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane; fixtures are busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network). Unverified until the combined pass (CI rootless Ubuntu; the Fedora 45 VM gate with `ausearch -m avc` empty).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/work/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) (drgnx-agents-net-hosts ((packages \"fixture.drgnx.test:18080\"))) (drgnx-sandbox-proxy-pinned-addresses (("fixture.drgnx.test" . "127.0.0.1"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

argv: echo up; while :; do ip route | grep -q . && echo route-appeared; nc -w 1 1.1.1.1 443 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo reached-out; sleep 1; done
